notes.bike: Protected = bike paths, multi-use paths and protected bike lanes, as mapped in OpenStreetMap. Painted lanes and sidewalks don't count.
notes.bike_crashes: Same network; bike crashes (Boulder PD, 2018–24) reweight Grow ordering and Fix gap ranking. Link unchanged.
notes.shared: Sidewalks and walking paths that OpenStreetMap marks as open to bikes also count as protected, so streets with one look covered. Fix isn't run: with most streets covered, its gaps mean little.
notes.shared_crashes: Sidewalks count as protected, and bike crashes reweight Grow. Link unchanged; Fix not run.
